_note: Team 3 (Audio). Contract between tools/generate_audio.py and Unity. Music ids must match the constants in unity/Assets/Scripts/Core/MusicCues.cs; SFX ids must match SfxPlayer.Ids. Never name artists, composers, songs or game franchises in a prompt (provider terms + the derivative-identity issue in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
music_style: Instrumental soundtrack for an original stylized anime mystery visual novel set in a locked boarding school. No vocals, no lyrics.
loop_rules: Steady tempo from the very first beat, no intro, no outro, no fade-in, no fade-out, no final chord, constant energy from start to end so the track can loop seamlessly.

music.prompt: Mysterious, curious and slightly playful. Soft pizzicato strings, celesta, muted piano and light brushed percussion. Calm unease, like walking empty school corridors at night.
Sudden shock settling into dread. Low sustained strings, deep piano clusters, a ticking clock and distant metallic hits. Tense and eerie, never violent.
Focused, suspenseful detective groove. Steady synth bass pulse, clean electric piano, crisp hi-hats and short string stabs. Thinking music, not action music.
Urgent detective groove, time is running out. Driving synth bass ostinato, fast hi-hats, rising string tremolo and a heartbeat kick drum.
Dramatic, confrontational debate theme. Driving orchestral string ostinato, punchy taiko and snare, bold brass hits over an electronic beat. High contrast and high stakes.
Short triumphant resolution with bright brass and strings, a feeling of relief, ending on a clear final chord.
Short dark ending with a descending piano line over low strings, finishing on one long low note.

sfx.prompt: Board game wooden dice bouncing and clattering onto a hard wooden table, several fast hollow wood taps slowing down to a stop, crisp foley sound effect, close mic, dry room.
Loud old school bell alarm ringing urgently in an empty corridor, long reverb tail.
Footsteps of school shoes walking at a steady pace on a wooden corridor floor.
Heavy wooden classroom door creaking open slowly.
Short bright sparkling chime for discovering a clue, video game interface sound.
Single tiny muted marimba tap, soft wooden UI dialogue tick, clean dry short plop, no reverb, minimal game text scroll blip..
Hard wooden judge gavel bang, crisp wood impact, leading into a dissonant low trombone and cello downward slide, ominous wrong verdict failure cue.
Gavel strike followed by a short low descending dissonant sting.
